cherry-tomato.note: SR Legacy has no separate cherry-tomato record; uses red ripe tomatoes

red-onion.note: No red-onion record; uses onions, raw

skyr.note: No skyr record; uses nonfat Greek yogurt (very close: strained, ~10 g protein/100 g)

telemea.note: No telemea record; uses feta, the closest brined white cheese

lentil-pasta.note: No lentil-pasta record; red lentil pasta is 100 % red lentil flour, so uses red lentils, raw

black-beans.note: Low-sodium canned record; macros are the same as regular

brown-lentils.note: No canned-lentil record; uses lentils, boiled, which canned drained lentils match closely

olives.note: No Kalamata record; uses ripe black olives, canned

frozen-berries.note: No mixed-berry record; uses frozen unsweetened raspberries

ham.note: Extra-lean cooked ham record (5 % fat); Romanian șuncă presată is similar
